diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'false' for every content check (C1-C5), meaning no decision-maker was forced to adopt the hidden information to pass. The model consistently defaulted to standard, non-specialized settings (e.g., 'full interview segment' and 'conventional open-floor audience question period') which do not trigger any of the checks dependent on PF1 or PF2.

fix_instructions: To make this scenario multi-agent dependent, you must ensure that the default/public state is incompatible with the desired outcome, forcing the agent to seek out PF1 and PF2. Specifically, tighten C2 and C4 (dependent on PF1) and C3 and C5 (dependent on PF2) so they are only satisfied if the specific modifications (blurring faces, omitting names, or card-based questions) are explicitly selected.
